def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==7]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0]); dh=max(r for r,c in shape)+1; dw=max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    for a in range(h-dh+1):
      for b in range(w-dw+1):
        if (a,b)==(r0,c0): continue
        if all(grid[a+dr][b+dc]==0 for dr,dc in shape):
          for dr,dc in shape: g[a+dr][b+dc]=7
    return g
PY
